text: Assumption: One instance of <Trigger> is instantiated per declared trigger as a member of the service skeleton and shares its life cycle — is this correct?

norm: one instance of trigger is instantiated per declared trigger as a member of the service skeleton and shares its life cycle
assumption: One instance of <Trigger> is instantiated per declared trigger as a member of the service skeleton and shares its life cycle.
rationale: The payload defines <Trigger> as service skeleton class for each trigger defined in the ServiceInterface.
